entries.spokenText: Can't you see I'm talking to this pretty, bearded lass here?
Good thing I was wearing my great-grandfather's helmet!
I don't think so!
Wench, bring some drinks for my friends!
Drink up, friend!
You have this. I'm waiting for the good stuff!
Now this stuff is actually good! Try some!
Uuurp! That hit the spot!
Spike it with Firewater
The Wench thinks you should stop playing with the drinks.
Stop using my head as a table!
Hey! You almost damaged the beard!
Impressive Dwarven War Belch!
Tip the Wench.
Oh, Hey! This looks like a serious game.
Leave me be! I'm trying to read lore here!
I don't think so!
Wench, please allow me to pay for these drinks with a song!
A toast! To my friends!
I do so hate to drink alone...
The Wench thinks you should stop playing with the drinks.
And now I'm going to play something really sad.
Excuse me... I think you're sitting on my tuning fork.
Oh, I hate it when the strings break!
How about a rowdy drinking song?
Allow me to introduce you to my biggest fan.
Who knew? One of my fans is a priest!
I've composed a poem about our most recent adventure.
This is in payment for that heroic ballad I wrote about you!
Tip the Wench.
Shut up!
Gog not think so!
This taste yucky!
Sorry, Gog not see you sitting there...
Dance with Gog!
Gog loves everyone!
Gambling? I'm in!
